response.rationale: “Perjalanan dinas” is the ordinary Indonesian term, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “perjalanan kerja” for a trip taken for work. The contrast is useful and the senses align.
response.risk_rationale: Register and context may affect whether Malaysian speakers prefer “perjalanan kerja” or the more formal “perjalanan perniagaan.”
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Malaysian Malay also uses “perjalanan perniagaan,” especially in formal contexts, but “perjalanan kerja” remains a credible everyday preference; this does not invalidate the contrast.
